paragraphs: 4 former Mustangs appeared in professional games on Saturday for 4 clubs across 3 levels, with Ryan Tayman producing the night's most notable performance.
Ryan Tayman tied the game in the first with a groundout.
St. Lucie Mets fell to Daytona Tortugas, 7-15.

Andrew Alvarez also appeared for Washington Nationals. He worked 5.1 innings, allowing 3 hits and 1 earned run, with 1 walk and 2 strikeouts. He started at P. Washington Nationals beat Cincinnati Reds, 8-2.
Brooks Lee also appeared for Minnesota Twins. He went 0-for-4. He batted 8th and started at 3B. Minnesota Twins fell to Milwaukee Brewers, 3-4.

Steven Brooks also appeared for Portland Sea Dogs at Double-A. He worked 2.0 innings, allowing 5 hits and 3 earned runs, with 1 walk and 2 strikeouts. He started at P. Portland Sea Dogs fell to New Hampshire Fisher Cats, 0-14.

title: Ryan Tayman delivers in a key spot
